svg.aria-label: Acetyllysine (Kac), ubiquitinated lysine (Kub: isopeptide bond to Gly76 of ubiquitin) and SUMOylated lysine (Ksu: isopeptide bond to the C-terminal Gly of SUMO)
svg.desc: Side chains from the C-alpha (wavy bond to the backbone), drawn from SMILES with RDKit (tools/make_ptm_art.py): Kac *CCCCCNC(C)=O; Kub *CCCCCNC(=O)CN*; Ksu *CCCCCNC(=O)CN*
